T_SEPARATE.note: Separate 87T uses selected HV breaker-side or bushing CT and a usable LV terminal CT. Different HV cuts change breaker and lead coverage.

B_FULL.note: Separate 87B uses the transformer LV incomer, collector boundaries and measured auxiliary tap if applicable. An unmeasured tap needs engineering review.

TB_COMBINED.note: Combined compensated differential uses selected HV CT plus collector boundaries and any required tap measurement. LV incomer CT is outside this input set. Verify grouping, inrush and sensitivity.

L_87L.note: Illustrative 87L uses remote CT and local transformer-side breaker CT. With a station POI-side CT, proposed spans overlap at the HV breaker. Check remote clearing and communications.

sources.locator: Line-Charging Current Compensation and Time-Overcurrent Differential Protection

T_REF_BACKUP.note: REF depends on grounding and winding phase and neutral CTs. Evaluate time-graded backup separately from primary and secondary protection.

BF_LOCAL_REMOTE.note: Breaker failure requires verified alternate isolation of all remaining sources. CT-defined boundaries and trip paths are separate.

SHARED_IED.note: Shared hardware keeps separate 87T and 87B zones. Verify exact SKU simultaneous element support, CT input allocation and A/B independence.

REDUNDANCY_ARCHITECTURES.note: Two overall differential paths, overall Primary plus separate transformer/bus Secondary, and duplicated separate transformer/bus zones are documented alternatives. The cited application uses transformer dual-breaker terminals, not this collector topology; evaluate CT security/sensitivity, clearing and owner acceptance separately. Duplication does not establish independent cores, DC or trips.

sources.locator: Section IV.C–D, Figs. 13–15, pp. 13–15; dual-breaker application, not a collector-station approval
